title: The Dancing Plague of 1518
description: In Strasbourg in 1518, a group of people began dancing uncontrollably, and contemporary accounts describe the episode spreading to many others. Historians and researchers still debate its causes and scale.

scenes.narration: In the summer of 1518, a woman in Strasbourg reportedly began dancing in the street and could not stop.
